title: Grade 5 Field Trip to the City Science Museum
source_body:
Grade 5 Field Trip to the City Science Museum

Dear parents and students,

Our Grade 5 students will visit the City Science Museum. They will see robots, dinosaur bones, and a space show.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School playground (The bus leaves at 8:40 a.m.)
Cost: 12,000 won (bus and ticket)
What to bring: lunch box, water bottle, notebook, pencil

Please note:
- Wear comfortable shoes.
- Do not bring toys or games.
- Stay with your group at all times.

Please return the permission form by Friday, October 31.

Grade 5 Field Trip to the City Science Museum

Dear parents and students,

We are delighted to announce that our Grade 5 students will be visiting the City Science Museum next month. During their visit, they will have a chance to see moving robots and actual dinosaur bones, and they will also experience an exciting space show.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School playground (The bus departs at 8:40 a.m., so please don't be late.)
Cost: 12,000 won (including the bus and the museum ticket)
What to bring: a lunch box, a water bottle, a notebook, and a pencil

Please note:
- Students should wear comfortable shoes because they will walk a lot.
- Students should not bring any toys or games.
- Students must stay with their group at all times.

Please make sure to return the signed permission form by Friday, October 31.
variants.prestudy:
Grade 5 Field Trip to the City Science Museum

Dear parents and students,

We are pleased to inform you that our Grade 5 students will be taking an educational field trip to the City Science Museum. Throughout the visit, students will have the opportunity to observe robots in action, examine genuine dinosaur skeletons, and experience an immersive space show that brings the universe to life.

Date: Thursday, November 6
Time: 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Meeting place: School playground (Please note that the bus will depart promptly at 8:40 a.m.)
Cost: 12,000 won (covering both transportation and admission)
What to bring: a packed lunch, a water bottle, a notebook, and a pencil

Important reminders:
- Since students will be walking for most of the day, comfortable footwear is strongly recommended.
- Toys and games are not permitted during the trip.
- For safety reasons, students are required to remain with their assigned group at all times.

Kindly return the completed permission form no later than Friday, October 31. We appreciate your cooperation.
